Notes 
Please send the application form to the SKLMCAS office by email.
The period of research will be from January 1, 2027 to December 31, 2028.
The maximum budget for the two-year period is 200,000 RMB.
The type of research can be “Fundamental” or “Applied fundamental”.
The deadline for submission is October 10, 2026.
